training.action_rule: K4H frozen all-low, all-center, all-high, even .2/odd .8 joint positions
training.world_rule: K4H public task constructors, reaching three goals offset by (dx,dy), pushing tool and goal block offset oppositely in x and goal in y
training.FIT_source_test: Count unique best actual action across twelve FIT contexts within each family. FIT action-rank diversity >=2 required for that family's information-sufficiency finding.
training.early_stop: If BOTH families have fewer than two unique FIT-best actions, stop after FIT and preserve CHECK and DEV completely unconsumed. Otherwise proceed with all frozen models/cohorts without tuning.
training.first_use: No CHECK/DEV outcome may affect predictor training, hyperparameters, feature selection, or model choice.

features: Same 128 public flattened tanh(x/0.5) reset observation as K4H; no hidden simulator state/variant ID/future reward
normalized_features: FIT-only centering divided by max(FIT std, 0.05) per public feature column
success: For a family with FIT diversity and two or more distinct DEV reset observations, a predeclared contextual method must improve mean DEV return by >=0.01 over trained family mean and choose different actions between new DEV contexts. Report each method without selection by DEV; any best-of-methods is exploratory/multiple-comparison.
controls: FIT 12 contexts x four actual arms per family. Every fitted model sees same data. CHECK diagnostic only. DEV actions chosen from read-only reset observation and frozen fitted state before actual DEV reward evaluation. Retain all negatives.
resources: Report original raw FIT CHECK DEV physics rewards, independent resets, task/state hashes, FIT diversity, CPU/wall RSS, checkpoint size.
